(rule!
 ;; Rectangles of the second-most-common color hold marker dots. A KEY
 ;; glyph sits outside them (rooted at the densest marker): its cells
 ;; two steps out from the center give the four ARM colors, its whole
 ;; footprint is the STAMP. For every marker inside a rectangle, draw
 ;; the arms out to the rectangle's edges in the arm colors, then stamp
 ;; the key pattern around the marker (clipped to the rectangle's
 ;; bbox). The key itself is erased.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define all-colors (grid-colors g -999))
     (define bg (pick-max all-colors (lambda (c) (count-color g c))))
     (define rect-color
       (pick-max (filter (lambda (c) (not (= c bg))) all-colors)
                 (lambda (c) (count-color g c))))
     (define rects
       (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) rect-color)
                                (>= (obj-size o) 10)))
               (objects g bg)))
     (define (inside? r c rect)
       (and (>= r (obj-r1 rect)) (<= r (obj-r2 rect))
            (>= c (obj-c1 rect)) (<= c (obj-c2 rect))))
     (define (inside-any? r c)
       (any? (lambda (rect) (inside? r c rect)) rects))
     (define marker-color
       (mode-list (for*/list ((rect rects)
                              (r (range (obj-r1 rect) (+ (obj-r2 rect) 1)))
                              (c (range (obj-c1 rect) (+ (obj-c2 rect) 1)))
                              #:when (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                       (and (not (= v bg))
                                            (not (= v rect-color)))))
                    (at g r c))))
     (define key-center  ;; the outside marker in the densest 5x5 patch
       (pick-max (filter (lambda (p)
                           (and (= (at g (first p) (second p)) marker-color)
                                (not (inside-any? (first p) (second p)))))
                         (grid-positions g))
                 (lambda (p)
                   (for*/sum ((r (range (max 0 (- (first p) 2))
                                        (min h (+ (first p) 3))))
                              (c (range (max 0 (- (second p) 2))
                                        (min w (+ (second p) 3)))))
                     (if (= (at g r c) bg) 0 1)))))
     (define key-cells
       (connected-region g (first key-center) (second key-center)
                         (lambda (r c v) (and (not (= v bg))
                                              (not (inside-any? r c))))
                         8))
     (define offsets  ;; key footprint relative to its center, with colors
       (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first key-center))
                              (- (second p) (second key-center))
                              (at g (first p) (second p))))
            key-cells))
     (define (offset-color dr dc)
       (let ((hit (find-first (lambda (e) (and (= (first e) dr)
                                               (= (second e) dc)))
                              offsets)))
         (and hit (third hit))))
     (define arm-dirs  ;; (dr dc color) for each arm the key defines
       (filter third
               (list (list -1 0 (offset-color -2 0))
                     (list 1 0 (offset-color 2 0))
                     (list 0 -1 (offset-color 0 -2))
                     (list 0 1 (offset-color 0 2)))))
     (define (paint-arm out rect mr mc dir)
       (let ((dr (first dir)) (dc (second dir)) (color (third dir)))
         (cond ((= dr -1)
                (for/fold ((acc out)) ((r (range (obj-r1 rect) mr)))
                  (set-cell acc r mc color)))
               ((= dr 1)
                (for/fold ((acc out)) ((r (range (+ mr 1)
                                                 (+ (obj-r2 rect) 1))))
                  (set-cell acc r mc color)))
               ((= dc -1)
                (for/fold ((acc out)) ((c (range (obj-c1 rect) mc)))
                  (set-cell acc mr c color)))
               (else
                (for/fold ((acc out)) ((c (range (+ mc 1)
                                                 (+ (obj-c2 rect) 1))))
                  (set-cell acc mr c color))))))
     (define (paint-stamp out rect mr mc)
       (for/fold ((acc out)) ((e offsets))
         (let ((rr (+ mr (first e))) (cc (+ mc (second e))))
           (if (inside? rr cc rect)
               (set-cell acc rr cc (third e))
               acc))))
     (for/fold ((out (erase-cells g key-cells bg))) ((rect rects))
       (for/fold ((acc out))
                 ((m (for*/list ((r (range (obj-r1 rect)
                                           (+ (obj-r2 rect) 1)))
                                 (c (range (obj-c1 rect)
                                           (+ (obj-c2 rect) 1)))
                                 #:when (= (at g r c) marker-color))
                       (list r c))))
         (paint-stamp (for/fold ((a acc)) ((dir arm-dirs))
                        (paint-arm a rect (first m) (second m) dir))
                      rect (first m) (second m)))))))
